ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
SEEKR (Simulation-Enabled Estimation of Kinetic Rates) is a suite of
tools for computing the kinetics of molecular binding, unbinding, and
transport using multiscale milestoning combined with molecular dynamics
(via OpenMM) and, optionally, Brownian dynamics (via Browndye or SDA).
Note: this is distributed on conda-forge as "seekr". If/when a PyPI
release happens, it will use the name "seekr-kinetics" instead, since
PyPI's "seekr" is an unrelated, pre-existing k-mer-counting package.

name: seekr
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: seekr            # conda-forge name; PyPI "seekr" is a different, unrelated package —
  version: "3.1.3"       # if/when this is released to PyPI, use "seekr-kinetics" there instead

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/seekrcentral/seekr/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a6b9576190055afbd0e3d09eb453f2a0f4b13f65713d568d701ff560e0c3b510

build:
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --no-build-isolation -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77.0             # matches the PEP 639 license-fix bump upstream
    - versioningit >=3.0,<4.dev0    # matches the bump upstream; confirmed via `pip install -e .`
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - attrs
    - cattrs
    - numpy
    - scipy
    - matplotlib-base
    - pillow >=10
    - mdtraj
    - netcdf4
    - parmed
    - pytest
    - networkx
    - pygt
    - openmm >=8              # not in pyproject.toml (not pip-installable) — added by hand
  run_constraints:
    # optional BD engines for k-on calculations; install alongside seekr, not as an extra
    - browndye >=1            # linux-64 only upstream
    # sda: no conda-forge/bioconda package exists yet; license needs checking before packaging

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - seekr
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "import openmm; import seekr; print(seekr.__version__)"
    requirements:
      run:
        - openmm

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/seekrcentral/seekr/
  repository: https://github.com/seekrcentral/seekr/
  documentation: https://seekr.readthedocs.io/
  summary: Simulation-Enabled Estimation of Kinetic Rates
  description: |
    SEEKR (Simulation-Enabled Estimation of Kinetic Rates) is a suite of
    tools for computing the kinetics of molecular binding, unbinding, and
    transport using multiscale milestoning combined with molecular dynamics
    (via OpenMM) and, optionally, Brownian dynamics (via Browndye or SDA).
    Note: this is distributed on conda-forge as "seekr". If/when a PyPI
    release happens, it will use the name "seekr-kinetics" instead, since
    PyPI's "seekr" is an unrelated, pre-existing k-mer-counting package.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - lvotapka
